reporting.lead_count_definition: Open opportunities in the two PROJECT pipelines (not the STORE pipeline). Tag-count metrics (leads_hot ... leads_stale) are lifetime contact tags across all 8,191 contacts, not today only.

exclusions.new_leads_excluded_note: The two excluded contacts are a job-seeker caller and a commercial-lease pitch on Instagram (non-customer inbound; flagged supplier-solicitation).
exclusions.unanswered_excluded_note: Each thread is counted once, in the first matching bucket (missed call, then to-action, then backlog). Net = 9 reply-list threads plus 1 open call commitment by us.

leads_by_source._scope: contacts created in the last 30 days

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline holds 66 opportunities; 28 open in '3. + 8d - Final Follow-up (Auto)', 13 still status open in '6a. Closed - Won' and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost'. No stale thresholds are defined; no store win today.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Days in stage before GHL applies the `stale_lead` tag. Keys are EXACT live stage names, including prefixes and trailing spaces.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway. Gap = appointment date minus stage-entry date, taken from the latest past appointment on the calendars.

reporting.stale_automation_signal: 41 open opportunities are already past their stage threshold with no stale_lead tag, and 850 contacts carry stale_lead; the tagging step does not look to be running on a schedule.
reporting.data_sources_note: GHL MCP tools were not available to this run. Contacts, opportunities, pipelines, calendar events and conversations were read through scripts/ghl_client.py (GET-only, same read-only PIT token). Opportunity notes (query_getNotes) and appointment notes were NOT read.
data_gaps: timeline/urgency custom fields not read, so tag_matches_timeline is null on new_leads
